entries.title: Temple of Portunus · Fletcher-based exterior interpretation

sources.title: Fletcher 1921, p.105 · Portunus plan and elevations
sources.publisher: Penn State University Libraries · courtesy Allan Kohl
sources.citation: WB2007-0510. Historic illustration visually reviewed at linked larger resolution. Holder declares public-domain use; reconstruction drawings are interpretive. No image pixels used in model materials.

sources.title: Tempio di Portunus · heritage authority
sources.publisher: Soprintendenza Speciale Archeologia Belle Arti e Paesaggio di Roma
sources.citation: Direct text review: identity, Ionic order, frontal columns, structural materials and Republican rebuilding context. No images copied.

sources.title: Temple of Portunus · city location and description
sources.citation: Direct text review: geographic POINT, high podium, steps and side-column description. Point is a visitor location, not a surveyed model anchor.

features.title: Ionic exterior and four-column front
features.note: Building-specific structural arrangement; simplified capital geometry is interpretive.

features.title: Dimensional scaffold
features.note: Transcribed printed feet converted to metres; diagram-derived width/depth breakdown and proportions are not modern survey measurements.

features.title: Podium, cella, engaged columns and pediments
features.note: Authored from the historic plan/elevations; wall thickness, spacing and mouldings are simplified approximations.

features.title: Roof, stairs, capitals and finishes
features.note: Roof form follows the drawing. Tile pattern, step count, volutes and neutral/terracotta colours are modelling conventions, not verified ancient details.

features.title: Location, orientation and grounding
features.note: City visitor point used for discovery. Approximate north-facing pose and terrain contacts are display inferences, not surveyed alignment.

features.title: Classical preview context
features.note: AD 100 is an editorial preview year, not a construction date or an exact source-attested snapshot. Temporal uncertainty is retained and explicit interpretation selection is required.

limitations: Exterior interpretation from a historic reconstruction drawing, not certified archaeological restitution.
Interior, cult furnishings, sculpture and original polychromy are omitted.
Grounding, roof covering and ornamental detail remain inferred.

rights.title: Project-authored model; repository terms apply
rights.attribution: Mankind geometry; reference: Banister Fletcher (1921), p.105, via Penn State University Libraries / Allan Kohl.
rights.note: No imported mesh or image textures. Historic drawing is designated public domain by its holder. This record does not grant a new public licence for the project.

reviews.note: Usable as an evidence-labelled exterior interpretation, with inferred dimensions/details and uncertain preview date retained. Not an expert-certified survey reconstruction. Model frame, source provenance and file integrity reviewed.
